name: popsicle
headline: IntelliContent: AI Content Generation Platform
short_description: IntelliContent is an AI-powered content generation platform that helps users create, manage, and share text, code, and marketing content through a modern SaaS dashboard. Built with FastAPI and React, it supports multiple AI models (OpenAI, Anthropic, local), exports (PDF, Markdown, DOCX, JSON), analytics, and admin tools.
author: Kaleshi26

sections.overview:
IntelliContent is a FastAPI and React-based SaaS platform that enables users to generate diverse content types—including blog posts, emails, code, summaries, and translations—powered by configurable AI models (OpenAI, Anthropic, or local). The platform provides content management with CRUD operations, public sharing links, and exports to PDF, Markdown, DOCX, and JSON formats. Built-in analytics track user activity and system usage, while role-based access control, email verification, and session management ensure secure multi-user environments. Teams benefit from batch generation, prompt optimization, rate limiting, and caching for efficient workflow automation.
Marketing teams generating blog posts, email campaigns, and social media content at scale
Software developers creating code snippets and technical documentation
Content creators producing summaries, translations, and creative writing
Enterprises managing content approval workflows with analytics and admin controls

sections.usage:
```
Create a 500-word blog post for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] about [TOPIC]. Include an introduction, three main sections with subheadings, and a conclusion. Use a professional but engaging tone. Optimize for SEO with relevant keywords: [KEYWORDS].
```
